already_permitted.representation: canonical JSON with compact ASCII serialization
already_permitted.relation: same canonical JSON data/fields,original agreed JSON semantics
decode exactly to full canonical raw payload and verify byte length/hash;compression ratio unassumed

proposed_L1.representation: immutable source/control content reference with exact SHA,field locator,decoder contract
proposed_L1.inverse: fetch exact pinned bytes,parse/extract exact field and reproduce original canonical value
proposed_L1.restrictions: observed metadata must first match original expected identity;unverified expected value cannot stand in for observation

proposed_L1.representation: single full content-addressed event plus sequence/hash/field references
proposed_L1.inverse: all referenced bytes available in declared budget;validate chain and field hashes

proposed_L2.representation: bounded descriptor with per-field omission/unrendered flags;no arbitrary __str__/__repr__ requirement
proposed_L2.original_digest_available_rule: true only after actual complete original byte processing;partial/normalized digest is a separately typed digest
proposed_L2.original_length_rule: UNKNOWN when not reliably measured;retained length is separate

current_R35_flags.FULL_CONTRACT_ACCEPTED: cannot be true for limited failure evidence

availability_boundary: unwritable storage may leave only confirmed prefix/native nonzero;no statement of full durable L0 preservation in that path

proposed_representation_limits.units: JSON reference/diagnostic fields:final compact ensure_ascii bytes including escaping;raw logs:actual UTF8 bytes
proposed_representation_limits.omission_reason: finite field/type/reason identifiers plus original length128bit or UNKNOWN and original digest64hex or UNKNOWN
proposed_representation_limits.joint_payload_capacity_proof: still unproved;these are proposed representation limits,not a fit theorem
proposed_representation_limits.L2_log_serialization: UTF8 raw file bytes,not JSON escaped bytes

proposed_verifier_responsibilities: bind contract ID/hash and approval identity
verify original raw size/hash and strict codec decode
resolve every L1 pointer to exact existing declared bytes/field with inverse equality
verify all authoritative L0 events/headers before treating diagnostic loss as permitted
verify per-field omission/digest/length claims reflect actual processing
verify source scope completeness and never bless omitted sources
verify actual confirmed I/O/exit observations rather than intended/predicted values
independently prove per-file and total wire sizes with all duplicates/references counted
reject full acceptance if any L0/source/ownership/required reference is missing
